biggest_catch: Zero guaranteed sales: you must create, list, and market competitive digital products, and Etsy charges a $0.20 listing fee per item (renewed on sale) plus 6.5% transaction fees and payment processing — you pay before you ever sell.
catches: $0.20 listing fee per listing (auto-renewed when the item sells); non-refundable even with zero sales — upfront_fee is true.
6.5% transaction fee on the total sale price plus payment-processing fees (varies by country; US commonly 3% + $0.25).
Offsite Ads can add another 12–15% on attributed sales.
Deep competition in printables, templates, and presets — no sales are guaranteed.
Digital delivery must be instant and as described — disputes and bad reviews hurt the shop.
